ios.desc:
Stop unwanted SMS and text messages with Bouncer, the powerful spam blocker and text filter that puts you back in control. Block scam texts, political messages, phishing attempts, and junk SMS instantly. A perfect and private alternative to expensive SMS blockers like Robokiller.

Features:

- Advanced Text Message Filter:
Block unwanted SMS, stop spam texts, and filter junk messages automatically. Bouncer detects and stops promotional texts, political SMS spam, scam messages, and phishing attempts. Keep your inbox clean from unwanted text notifications.

- Complete Privacy Protection:
Your text messages never leave your phone. No servers involved - all SMS filtering happens on your device.

- Smart Message Blocking:
Create custom filters to block specific SMS keywords, stop unwanted texts from specific numbers, and filter out any type of junk messages. Perfect for stopping political texts, blocking scam SMS, and filtering promotional messages.

- Automatic Notification Control
Stop notifications from spam texts and junk SMS automatically. Only get alerted for messages that matter.

- Easy SMS Management:
Works seamlessly with your Messages app to block unwanted texts. No complicated setup - just install and start blocking spam messages instantly

- Advanced Filtering Rules (PCRE):
Use powerful regular expressions to create custom text filters and stop any type of unwanted SMS.

- 100% transparent and open source:
Check out the code on GitHub: https://github.com/afterxleep/Bouncer

Stop spam texts today with Bouncer - your personal SMS spam blocker and text message filter!

quotes.text:
Bouncer (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/bouncer-text-messages-blocker/id1457476313 / https://github.com/afterxleep/Bouncer) is a free and open source SMS filtering app that has saved my sanity over the past couple of years. You need to manually set up filters, but once you do, the amount of political spam drops to 0.

It uses iOS’s SMS Filtering framework, which does the filtering in a privacy-preserving way: https://developer.apple.com/documentation/sms_and_call_reporting/sms_and_mms_message_filtering/
